earnings.title: Ovintiv Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Operating Results
highlights: Generated third quarter net earnings of $549 million, cash from operating activities of $1.1 billion, Non-GAAP Cash Flow of $1.2 billion and Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow of $680 million after capital expenditures of $563 million

Returned approximately 69% ($467 million) of third quarter Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow to shareholders via share repurchases of approximately $386 million (6.3 million shares) and dividend payments of $81 million
Recognized net gains on risk management in revenues of $27 million, before tax
Generated cash from operating activities of $1.1 billion and Non-GAAP Cash Flow of approximately $1.2 billion

Reported third quarter upstream operating expense of $3.43 per barrel of oil equivalent (“BOE”), upstream transportation and processing costs of $8.12 per BOE, production, mineral and other taxes of $1.03 per BOE, or 2.7% of upstream product revenue

quotes.text: Our third quarter results demonstrate the ongoing commitment of our team to create value across the business, and we are on track to achieve record annual free cash flow.
quotes.by: Ovintiv President and CEO, Brendan McCracken

outlook: Full year 2026 shareholder returns expected to exceed 60% of Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow
Maintained full year 2026 guidance, generating approximately 6% oil and condensate production per share growth over the last six months and on pace for 8% to 9% per share growth by year end
Third quarter capital investment of $563 million was below the midpoint of the guidance range of $550 million to $600 million
Ovintiv expects full year 2026 shareholder returns to total more than 60% of Non-GAAP Free Cash Flow.

items.heading: A substantial or extended decline in oil, NGLs or natural gas prices, or a substantial increase in oil, NGLs and natural gas price differentials, could have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, results of operations, and the trading prices of our securities.
The trading price of our securities, including our common stock, is subject to volatility.
Fluctuations in exchange rates could affect expenses or result in realized and unrealized losses.
Our ability to operate and complete projects is dependent on numerous factors outside of our control.
Our operations involve many risks, some of which could result in unforeseen interruptions and expose us to substantial losses and liabilities, for which our insurance may not fully protect us.
Oil and natural gas exploration, development and production activities involve substantial costs and risks and may not result in commercially productive reserves.
